verdict.rationale: Supabase documents event-driven automation natively. Database Webhooks fire HTTP requests on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE table events and can target any endpoint, including Edge Functions. Cron runs SQL, functions, or HTTP calls on a schedule, and Queues add durable background tasks. Realtime Postgres Changes lets clients listen to database events. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these triggers work as documented, and explicit documentation of an AI agent defining these rules (only implied via the MCP execute_sql/apply_migration tools).
